protocol.archive_sources: Not included. Historical source hashes identify the recorded implementation, not the current standalone package.
protocol.evaluation_truncation: recorded and continued; unresolved guard episodes are censored
protocol.training_truncation: ignored; no artificial training timeout penalty

provenance.configuration_scope: Scientific settings only; display-only settings are omitted from the exported configuration.
provenance.omitted_artifacts: Checkpoint binaries and runtime logs are not included. Source snapshots are available only when source_snapshot_status is included and their files are listed in the bundle manifest.
provenance.source_hash_scope: Historical fingerprints identify source components used for the recorded study; they do not identify current package files or establish source availability.
provenance.validation_at_extraction: Recorded config, seed banks, completed outputs and checkpoint hashes were verified at extraction; episode counts were recomputed. Portable analysis verifies the included records.
